description.text: Digitaler Zwilling-Modelltyp für ein industrielles Lithium-Ionen-Batteriemodul (48V / 100Ah). Enthält typbezogene Stammdaten, die für alle Instanzen dieses Modells gelten.
Digital Twin model type for an industrial Lithium-Ion battery module (48V / 100Ah). Contains type-level master data applicable to all instances of this model.

_metadata._comment: This is the TYPE LEVEL of the AAS. It encapsulates cross-model information that applies to ALL instances of this battery model. Instance-specific data (serial number, SoH, ownership) is located in the instance AAS (battery_module_001.json).
_metadata._regulatoryBasis: EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542, Art. 13, Art. 38, Annex XIII
